threads.title: [PILOT] Daily greeting: agree the three interfaces before building
threads.headline: greeting_context shipped (commit baf6811); editable-paths grant omits agent-svc/tests/ that the charter doc claims as…
threads.summary:
Three interfaces agreed for the daily greeting (ft_muk0zk573q8v1):

(1) Speaker primitive (conversation/character, Dev to build): `speaker_gate.say_once(text, origin="voice")` in speaker.py/speaker_gate.py — never touches _TURN/_ADDRESSED, publishes a new bus event type ("announce", distinct from "reply") so character doesn't render a reply-yield cue, goes through existing _say_gate(..., optional=True). Replaces the ad hoc pet-greet path too (one primitive, not two).

(2) greeting_context (experts, Mira, already built on emp/mira/as_muk3iokxghbmm): assembled and owned entirely inside greeting.py, reading context/weather.py, context/generators/system.py and experts/device.py directly. Fields: last_greeted_local_date (YYYY-MM-DD, local tz, null until first greeting, advances only after Speaker confirms delivery), weather_used ({place,rain,temp} | "none", verbatim from weather.py), on_call (bool|null, from system.py's presence.call, mic-based only — does NOT cover screen-share/meeting detection, that gap stays open per th_muk65j9udjztm), muted (bool|null, from device.py get_volume()). Null on the latter two means unknown and is never coerced to false. Full ACs on ft_mulrmufpu49uj.

(3) Memory (Kabir): no role. A greeting firing isn't a mem_events kind (said|outcome|feedback|work) and the consolidator explicitly excludes "what Iris said" (memory.py:670). No memory code touched by this feature.

Ownership correction folded in: experts/memory.py is memory-owned (both charters' existing docs already agreed — Experts' own charter carves it out, memory-client.md §1 row 47 confirms). The map/editable-paths entry was stale, not a live dispute; corrected here.

Each builds on its own emp/* branch with evidence; no merges into base branches; QA verifies.
